findings.one_line: The stated calibration in def:quotient-confidence-set is for permutation-minimized D_H, but the coverage proof replaces it by the stronger fixed-label Delta event; D_H<=c rho does not imply Delta<=c rho, so (1)--(3) and hence coverage are not derived. State/calibrate the fixed-label Delta event or prove the required permutation-compatible oracle bound.
